rules.law_name: Forbidding the Algorithmic Inflation of Rent (FAIR) Act
rules.effective_date_basis: The FAIR Act takes effect on July 1, 2027
rules.title: Prohibition on algorithmic rent-setting practices
rules.requirement: Residential rental property owners may not use algorithmic revenue management software that uses competitors' nonpublic leasing information to set or recommend rents. Software providers and other coordinators also may not use such software to facilitate agreements or coordinate pricing among competing residential landlords.
rules.key_value: Prohibits algorithmic revenue management software using competitors' nonpublic leasing information

coverage.other_unresolvable: Applies based on use of algorithmic revenue management software or an algorithmic device that uses nonpublic, competitively sensitive information from multiple residential rental property owners.
coverage.summary: Covers residential rental property owners, property managers, software providers, and other coordinators involved in algorithmic rent-setting for residential rental properties.

rules.exemptions: The act does not prohibit spreadsheets requiring human analysis, publicly available rent estimation tools, traditional real estate listing databases, or government-administered affordable housing programs.
rules.interaction: The document says the act preserves existing remedies under the New Jersey Antitrust Act.
rules.quoted_span: The FAIR Act prohibits residential rental property owners from using algorithmic revenue management software that collects or processes competitors' nonpublic leasing information to set or recommend rental prices.
